questions.prompt: Which part of a tool result does the model read?
options: Neither; it reads only the tool name
questions.explanation: content is the text or image the model reads. details is data for your own code and the screen, and pi does not send it to the model.

questions.prompt: The sql_query function throws an error halfway through. What does the model see?
options: An error result it can read
The old rows from the last call
questions.explanation: pi turns a thrown error into an error result, so the model can read it and try a different query.

questions.prompt: You register a tool without a promptSnippet. What is the effect?
options: The tool cannot run at all
The tool is left out of the tools list in the system prompt
The tool runs without a schema
questions.explanation: promptSnippet adds the tool's line to the prompt's tools list. Without it, a custom tool is left out of that list.
